text:
maria: quick sync: planning a micro release tonight (patch) for py/ts to address a packaging lint and update deprecation blurb. change window 23:30 UTC.
sam: heads-up: build image rotation still rolling; artifact-verify might intermittently fail. i'll run parallel runs.
anya: found stray .DS_Store in TS package in staging. repack recommended.
cheng: docs will include a short "how to pin" for customers + deprecation banner example.
maria: let's make the plan: try publish both; if TS fails, publish py only and tag TS as 'next' when clean. include rollback snippet.
lee: agree. also add a short internal note to support about pinning guidance.
devex-bot: reminder: release checklist requires at least 2 approvers on the release PR before flipping 'latest'.
maria: noted. sam, prioritize verifying the TS tarball contents before publish.
sam: running packaging sanity, removing .DS_Store and README.tmp if present. then publish under 'next'.
deploy-bot: artifact-verify passed for python 1.5.1. Typescript artifact verification failed: cached verifier image.
anya: pushing a quick fix to pipeline to update verifier.
sam: repack + publish TS under 'next' once verifier is clean. commands: npm pack && tar -tf package.tgz | grep -v '.DS_Store' && npm publish --tag next.
cheng: drafting release note: "patch release: packaging fixes; deprecation notice for sync client (sunset 2026-07-01); TypeScript published under 'next' pending verification."
maria: hold flip to 'latest' for 30m. add rollback commands: npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@1.5.0 latest && pip index versions redwood-sdk && remove wheel if needed.
lee: I'll coordinate support blurb and staging updates.
deploy-bot: package-publish event: redwood-sdk (python) 1.5.1 published.
sam: TS repack finished. publishing with tag 'next'. smoke tests running.
anya: smoke tests green.
maria: good. waiting 30m. I'll flip at 00:05 UTC if clean. thanks all. :tada:
